The file and SHA-256 of the vendored JAR are recorded in
[`scripts/catalog/inputs.json`](../../../scripts/catalog/inputs.json) under `anotherEdenPatcher`.
The verifier's contract check hashes the 12,106,851-byte file from the checkout.

Build 487 is the release JAR from [JingMatrix/LSPatch v1.2](https://github.com/JingMatrix/LSPatch/releases/tag/v1.2).
Its SHA-256 is `d238fdc414d121b7fa454d8b4ccf420df3a8c97d563761861ff92bd9c5da2165`,
matching the upstream release asset digest. [LICENSE](LICENSE) accompanies the unmodified JAR.
